item.question: An equilateral triangle has side 8 cm. Show that joining the midpoints of its sides makes 4 identical equilateral triangles.
steps: Each corner triangle has two sides of 8 ÷ 2 = 4 cm with the 60° angle of the big triangle between them.
It is isosceles, so its base angles are equal: (180° − 60°) ÷ 2 = 60° each.
All its angles are 60°, so it is equilateral and its third side is also 4 cm.
The middle triangle has the three third sides as its sides: 4 cm, 4 cm and 4 cm.
item.answer: Four equilateral triangles, each of side 4 cm

item.question: Find the number of holes, and the triangles that remain at each step of the shape sequence that leads to the Sierpinski Triangle.
steps: Each remaining triangle gives 3 remaining triangles at the next step: 1, 3, 9, 27, so the count at Step n is 3 to the power n.
Each remaining triangle also makes one new hole, and the old holes stay.
At Step n the holes are 1 + 3 + 9 + ... up to 3 to the power (n − 1), which equals (3 to the power n, minus 1) divided by 2.
item.answer: Remaining triangles: 3 to the power n. Holes: 1 + 3 + 9 + ... up to n terms, which is (3 to the power n, minus 1) divided by 2
item.text:
Figure it Out (sierpinski fractals, question 2): Find the number of holes, and the triangles that remain at each step of the shape sequence that leads to the Sierpinski Triangle.
1. Each remaining triangle gives 3 remaining triangles at the next step: 1, 3, 9, 27, so the count at Step n is 3 to the power n.
2. Each remaining triangle also makes one new hole, and the old holes stay.
3. Holes: 0, 1, 1 + 3 = 4, 1 + 3 + 9 = 13, and so on.
4. At Step n the holes are 1 + 3 + 9 + ... up to 3 to the power (n − 1), which equals (3 to the power n, minus 1) divided by 2.
Answer: Remaining triangles: 3 to the power n. Holes: 1 + 3 + 9 + ... up to n terms, which is (3 to the power n, minus 1) divided by 2

item.question: Start with an equilateral triangle of side 1 unit. Find the number of sides, the length of each side and the perimeter at Step 1 of the Koch Snowflake.
steps: Each side is cut into 3 parts of 1/3 unit, and the middle part is replaced by two sides of a bump.
So each side becomes 4 sides: 3 × 4 = 12 sides.
Each side is 1/3 unit long.
Perimeter = 12 × 1/3 = 4 units.

Answer: 12 sides, each 1/3 unit, perimeter 4 units

item.question: A diamond pattern has area 64 square cm. Each new shape is drawn by joining the midpoints of the sides of the one before. What is the area of the third shape inside?
